control.title: Consent withdrawal
control.description: Let users withdraw consent as easily as they gave it, and stop processing (including by processors) within a defined time.

implementation_notes: Owned by the Grievance Officer; process documented in the privacy runbook.
evidence_hint: Withdrawal mechanism and propagation procedure to processors.
acceptance_criteria: A withdrawal option as easy as giving consent
A procedure or log showing withdrawal is passed to processors

criteria_coverage.criterion: A withdrawal option as easy as giving consent

requirements.title: Withdrawal of consent
requirements.guidance: Let Data Principals withdraw consent at any time, with ease comparable to giving it.

requirements.title: Stop processing after withdrawal
requirements.guidance: After consent is withdrawn, stop processing (and make processors stop) within a reasonable time, unless another legal basis applies.
